run_engine_generate_questions: run the Engine module to generate visual reasoning questions from SUNCG house environments and save to JSON
executeFn_template_pipeline: execute a template pipeline like filter objects then blacklist then query to generate questions for a cached house
cacheHouse_parse_entities: cache a HouseParse object to build room and object entity graphs for question generation
queryExist_generate_yes_no: generate yes/no existence questions asking if an object is in a specific room
queryLogical_generate_and_or: generate logical questions with AND/OR operators asking about pairs of objects in a room
